title: Prompt: summarize a Conditional Access policy export
problem: You have a JSON export of CA policies and need a human-readable summary.
steps: Open Microsoft Copilot Chat (formerly Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat) or your approved AI tool.

Paste the JSON and use: 'You are a Microsoft Entra Conditional Access expert. Summarize each policy in this JSON as a table with columns: name, state, included users, excluded users, target resources, conditions, grant controls, session controls. Then list gaps (e.g., missing break-glass exclusions, policies stuck in report-only).'
Review the output critically and verify facts against official documentation.
pitfalls: Never paste secrets, tenant IDs or personal data into tools not approved for that data.
AI output can be wrong — treat it as a draft.
